jiamingshi-jsphys/chem-notes.html:
English | 简体中文

General Chemistry — Notes

This project contains lecture notes on general chemistry, written with the reusable chemistry.cls document class and typeset in LaTeX. Both English and Chinese versions are provided.

Author: Jiaming Shi, Department of Physics, Westlake University.

Compiled PDFs

The latest compiled PDFs are available on the Releases page:

  • General_Chemistry_en.pdf
  • General_Chemistry_zh.pdf

Or visit the latest Releases.

Compilation

Main documents:

General_Chemistry_en.tex
General_Chemistry_zh.tex

Compile the English version:

latexmk -xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error \
  -output-directory=build General_Chemistry_en.tex

To compile the Chinese version, replace the filename with General_Chemistry_zh.tex. All build artifacts are written to build/.

The Chinese version uses the chinese class option:

\documentclass[chinese]{chemistry}

This loads ctexart and switches environment names to Chinese. The English version uses:

\documentclass{chemistry}

Directory Structure

chem-notes/
├── General_Chemistry_en.tex
├── General_Chemistry_zh.tex
├── chemistry.cls
├── chapters_en/
├── chapters_zh/
├── build/
├── README.md
└── README_zh.md
  • chemistry.cls: shared document class containing the page layout, packages, fonts, theorem boxes, and custom macros.
  • General_Chemistry_en.tex / General_Chemistry_zh.tex: entry points for the English / Chinese versions.
  • chapters_en/ / chapters_zh/: chapter source files for the English / Chinese versions.
  • build/: build artifacts, excluded from Git.

Current Status

Chapters 1–3 are complete; Chapters 4–7 are in progress. The shared preamble lives in chemistry.cls, and each chapter contains only \section-level content. To add notes, create a new file in chapters_en/ or chapters_zh/ and add an \input line to the corresponding main file.

Reporting Issues

If you find a typo, a wrong equation, or a build issue, please open an issue and include the subject, page/section, and the exact line.

  • Repository: JiamingShi-JsPhys/chem-notes
  • Issues: JiamingShi-JsPhys/chem-notes/issues

jietexue/quantum-mechanics-notes.html:
Quantum Mechanics Notes - Fall 2025

Personal study notes for the Fall 2025 Quantum Mechanics course at Westlake University, taught by Congjun Wu. The notes are written primarily in English using LaTeX.

Instructor's lecture notes: Quantum Mechanics 2025.

These notes do not follow the order of the lectures. Topics, derivations, and computational methods are reorganized around my own understanding, with a strongly personal approach to selection, presentation, and emphasis. They are not official lecture notes or a complete record of the course, and may contain errors or omissions.

Contents

  • Foundations: quantization, Dirac notation, operators, commutators, compatible observables, and uncertainty relations.
  • Wave functions and dynamics: position and momentum representations, the Schrodinger equation, probability density and current, exponential operators, and the Baker-Hausdorff lemma.
  • Model systems: analytical and algebraic treatments of the harmonic oscillator, coherent states, gauge transformations, Landau levels, and the quantum Hall effect.
  • Angular momentum and symmetries: rotations, spherical harmonics, angular momentum addition, Clebsch-Gordan coefficients, parity, and time reversal.
  • Approximation methods: time-independent and time-dependent perturbation theory, the interaction picture, the Landau-Zener model, adiabatic evolution, and the Berry phase.
  • Path integrals and scattering: propagators, Feynman's path integral formulation, and partial-wave scattering.

Build

The main source is quantum-mechanics-notes.tex; illustrations and their SVG source are in figures/.

With a TeX distribution containing the required packages and latexmk installed, run from the repository root:

latexmk -pdf quantum-mechanics-notes.tex

Partial Differential Equations Notes / 偏微分方程笔记

Course taught by Prof. Alexey Cheskidov at Westlake University; notes compiled by Sida Wu / 西湖大学 Alexey Cheskidov 教授授课，Sida Wu 整理

Read the PDF / 阅读 PDF

Overview / 概述

This repository contains an evolving set of notes for the Partial Differential Equations course taught by Prof. Alexey Cheskidov at Westlake University. The current material covers selected topics in fluid dynamics and the one-dimensional heat equation, with derivations, examples, and explanatory remarks.

本仓库收录西湖大学 Alexey Cheskidov 教授所授偏微分方程课程的笔记，内容仍在持续整理。目前包含流体力学与一维热方程的部分内容，以及相关推导、例题和说明。

Course Textbook / 课程教材

The course syllabus lists Richard Haberman, Applied Partial Differential Equations with Fourier Series and Boundary Value Problems, 5th edition, as the textbook. See the publisher's book page.

课程大纲指定教材为 Richard Haberman 的 Applied Partial Differential Equations with Fourier Series and Boundary Value Problems，第 5 版。

Current Contents / 当前内容

PartEnglish中文
1Fluid dynamics流体力学
1.1Inviscid Burgers' equation, characteristics, and shock formation无黏 Burgers 方程、特征线与激波形成
1.2The incompressible Navier-Stokes equations不可压缩 Navier-Stokes 方程
1.3Kinetic energy and its evolution动能及其演化
1.4Evolution of the velocity gradient and enstrophy速度梯度的演化与涡量平方积分
2The one-dimensional heat equation一维热方程
2.1Stationary solutions and homogeneous boundary conditions稳态解与边界条件齐次化
2.2Separation of variables and Fourier sine series分离变量法与 Fourier 正弦级数
2.3Other boundary conditions and introductory Fourier series material其他边界条件与 Fourier 级数初步

mynotes.clsLocal document class / 本地文档样式

Reading Guide / 阅读建议

These notes are intended for course review and topic-based reference. Familiarity with multivariable calculus, linear algebra, and ordinary differential equations will be helpful. For a first systematic study of PDEs, use them alongside a textbook or a course.

本笔记适合课后复习与按主题查阅，阅读时需要多元微积分、线性代数和常微分方程的基础。首次系统学习偏微分方程时，建议结合教材或课程使用。

Build / 编译

Use a TeX distribution with CTeX and the packages required by mynotes.cls. The build is checked with TeX Live 2025 and XeLaTeX.

latexmk -xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error main.tex

If latexmk is unavailable, run XeLaTeX twice / 若未安装 latexmk，可运行两遍 XeLaTeX：

The output is main.pdf.

Ordinary Differential Equations

This repository contains the LaTeX source files for the Ordinary Differential Equations course notes.

  • Ordinary Differential Equations.tex: the main document, including document settings and chapter entries.
  • Chapters/: the source files for individual chapters.

Build

Install a recent full TeX Live distribution with XeLaTeX. From the repository root, run:

xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "Ordinary Differential Equations.tex"
xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "Ordinary Differential Equations.tex"

PDFs, original board photographs, temporary files, and build artifacts are excluded from version control.

Contributing

Typo fixes, mathematical corrections, and typesetting improvements are welcome. The notes will be updated as new chapters and corrections become available.
